speakers.headline: Senior Software Engineer
speakers.biographyMd: Danilo Deponti is a Senior Software Engineer, currently working in Doctolib, where he helps build the internal AI-augmented developer tools. His work focuses on autonomous coding agents, AI orchestration, and developer productivity, turning experimental LLM tooling into something teams can trust in production. He's passionate about pushing the boundaries of what AI can do inside a real engineering organisation: from agent fleets and persistent memory to observability, cost control, and keeping humans meaningfully in the loop.

talks.title: When the Backlog Dispatches Itself: a Production Fleet of Autonomous AI Coding Agents
